Since this is a mixed-environment cluster, let's make sure the VM runs only on production nodes.

Click on <span id="assignment.51.1"/>: <span id="ch1.intro1.2"/> offers three choices:

- <span id="assignment.51.2"/>: the <span id="assignment.2.2"/> scheduler chooses where to place the VM, and **live migration stays enabled**
- <span id="assignment.51.3"/>: pin the VM to one node (no migration possible)
- <span id="assignment.51.4"/>: affinity rules based on node labels (GPU capability, NUMA topology, network zone…)
